title: The Room at the Back
subtitle: 家庭生活 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 家庭生活（生活与学习·个人、家庭、社区及学校生活）
meta: 主题语境：家庭生活（生活与学习·个人、家庭、社区及学校生活）　|　核心词汇：bedroom　|　正文 338 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 bedroom 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1949 my mother was given ① a bedroom of her own for the first time at nineteen, and she said the door was the whole of the gift. The ② bedroom, meaning the room and not the door, was nine feet by eleven and was shared again within a year; a bedroom, she said, is the only room that is a promise before it is a place.

Every ③ bedroom in that house faced the same yard, and the ④ bedroom at the back, meaning the one with the cold wall and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever chose willingly. A bedroom, my grandmother said, is nine parts quiet and one part a window that shuts; my mother said the quiet is the part you notice.

My father meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ bedroom was the whole of the argument, meaning the privacy and not the room. The ⑥ bedroom, meaning the right to be alone and not any of that, is the only thing in a family that everybody claims and nobody can divide; a bedroom, he said, is either a room with a door or the only word that means both a place and a right. She said the right came first.

By 1969 the ⑦ bedroom had become a photograph in an advertisement, and the advertisement had become an argument about how many a house should have. The ⑧ bedroom of the whole thing, my mother wrote in June, was nine feet and eleven years of sharing; a bedroom, she said, is either the room at the back or the reason you learned to shut a window. He said the shutting was the part that mattered.

The ⑨ bedroom I remember is the one at the back, which was given away in 1971 and never got back. A ⑩ bedroom, my grandmother said in 1973, is the only room that improves by being promised; every bedroom, she said, is a right that has agreed to look like a place. She said the right was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: B. n. 卧室（指那间屋，与那扇门相对）
C. 固定搭配：be given a bedroom 得到／被分到一间卧室
D. n. 卧室（指屋里每一间）
E. n. 卧室（指后面那一间）
F. n. 隐私（指那场争论的核心）
G. n. 隐私（抽象：独处的权利）
H. n. 权衡；整件事的分量（抽象总称）

items.q: The bedroom, meaning the room and not the door
bedroom was the whole of the argument
The bedroom, meaning the right to be alone
the bedroom had become a photograph in an advertisement
The bedroom of the whole thing
A bedroom, my grandmother said in 1973

answers.why: be given a bedroom 意为“得到／被分到一间卧室”，1949 年母亲十九岁时第一次有了一间自己的卧室。
bedroom 意为“卧室”，指那间屋而不是那扇门，它九英尺宽十一英尺长，不到一年又与人合住。
bedroom 指屋里每一间卧室，每一间都朝着同一个院子。
bedroom 指后面那一间（有那堵冷墙的那一间），是唯一有人甘愿挑的。
bedroom 意为“隐私”，指那场争论的核心，父亲说 bedroom 就是那场争论的全部。
bedroom 为抽象用法，指独处的权利，是家里人人都主张、却谁也分不了的东西。
bedroom 意为“卧室”，到 1969 年这个 bedroom 成了广告里的一张照片。
bedroom 意为“权衡、整件事的分量”，母亲六月写道，整件事权衡下来是九英尺和十一年的合住。
bedroom 意为“卧室”，我记得的是后面那一间，1971 年被让出去，再没要回来。
bedroom 为抽象总称，祖母说卧室是唯一会因为被许诺而变好的房间。
